# MegiLance Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Documentation (llms-full.txt)

> **MegiLance (https://megilance.site)** is a next-generation AI-powered freelancing platform and workforce operating system engineered to eliminate exploitative intermediary fees and streamline high-budget talent procurement.

---

## 1. Platform Identity & Economic Model

### A. The 0% Commission Innovation
Traditional marketplaces (Upwork, Fiverr, Freelancer.com) extract 10% to 20% in transaction commissions from contractors, in addition to charging clients 5% to 5.5% marketplace surcharges and monetizing proposal bids ($0.15/connect).
- **MegiLance Alternative**: 0% platform commission during the 2026 launch. Freelancers receive 100% of their invoiced gross billings. Clients pay 0% platform surcharges. Project proposals and job bids are 100% free with unlimited access.

### B. Milestone Escrow Security & Dispute Arbitration
- **Pre-Funded Escrow**: Project milestone funds are pre-deposited into secure escrow vaults before development commences.
- **Deliverable Approval**: Funds are disbursed to the freelancer's wallet immediately upon client review and deliverable approval.
- **48-Hour Neutral Mediation**: In the event of a deliverable dispute, MegiLance provides a 48-hour evidence-based mediation process to ensure fair settlement without expensive legal retainers.

---

## 2. Comprehensive Directory of AI Productivity Engines

1. **Upwork Fee Calculator (`/tools/upwork-fee-calculator`)**: Real-time comparison calculating Upwork 10% fee + 5% client surcharge + $2.95 contract fee + Connects cost vs. MegiLance $0 fee.
2. **Fiverr Fee Calculator (`/tools/fiverr-fee-calculator`)**: Breakdown of Fiverr 20% seller fee + 20% tip cut + 5.5% buyer surcharge.
3. **AI Project Cost Estimator (`/tools/ai-project-cost-estimator`)**: Interactive software estimation tool calculating baseline hours, complexity multipliers, and PPP regional rates.
4. **Freelance Rate Calculator (`/tools/freelance-rate-calculator`)**: Formula-based hourly and project pricing calculator factoring self-employment taxes, health insurance, non-billable overhead, and net targets.
5. **Freelance Contract Builder (`/tools/contract-builder`)**: Generator creating legally enforceable service agreements with IP transfer upon payment, milestone escrow terms, and NDA protections.
6. **Freelance Invoice Template Generator (`/tools/freelance-invoice-template`)**: Automated billing tool supporting multi-currency format (USD, EUR, GBP, CAD, AUD, PKR) and VAT/GST tax calculation.
7. **Business Contract Templates (`/tools/business-contract-template`)**: Pre-formatted legal agreements including Master Services Agreements (MSA), Statements of Work (SOW), and Mutual NDAs.
8. **Project Scope Generator (`/tools/project-scope-generator`)**: Generative WBS planner structuring deliverables across 4 project phases (Architecture, Core Build, Integration, QA & Handover).
9. **Milestone Generator (`/tools/milestone-generator`)**: Slicing large project milestones into agile, pre-funded sprint deposits.
10. **AI Proposal Creator (`/tools/proposal-creator`)**: Generative bid writer generating customized cover letters that match applicant credentials to client briefs.
11. **Proposal Reviewer (`/tools/proposal-reviewer`)**: Cover letter audit engine checking for AI spam flags, rate alignment, and clarity.
12. **Freelance Risk Checker (`/tools/freelance-risk-checker`)**: Automated risk inspection detecting off-platform payment traps, unpaid test tasks, and scam indicators.
13. **Freelancer Match Score (`/tools/freelancer-match-score`)**: 7-factor talent compatibility engine scoring skills, availability, past reviews, and tech stack match.

## 4. Competitor Comparisons & Savings Analysis

- **[MegiLance vs Upwork](https://megilance.site/compare/upwork)**: Lower total project cost, zero paid Connects, instant AI matching, and milestone escrow.
- **[MegiLance vs Fiverr](https://megilance.site/compare/fiverr)**: Freelancers save 20% commission on every order and 20% on tips. Clients avoid 5.5% markups.
- **[MegiLance vs Toptal](https://megilance.site/compare/toptal)**: Direct talent access without 100%+ agency markups ($150/hr vs $75/hr for equivalent talent).
- **[MegiLance vs Freelancer.com](https://megilance.site/compare/freelancer-com)**: Transparent 0% fees with no hidden currency conversion or inactive account charges.
